title: Preserve child identity and working errors through common-runner retirement
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The actual common runner in #6864 can reap its direct child before its final numeric process-group signal. #6866 supplies a counterexample and retained-child construction. This contribution installs that construction into the connected runner and rebuilds both immutable stage recipes and their caller/source pins.

The consequential Pro review also found that the actual enclosing `science.lock` context could mask the working exception with a close error. The corrected actual `main` retains separate preallocated working/close errors, closes a known handle once, preserves the working error, and delays expected administrative exit 1 until lock retirement succeeds. A close failure remains visible to the existing stderr-sensitive refusal predicate.

The completed contribution is an inert source archive under `research/h25-retained-child-lock-repair/`, with actual corrected owner source, literal predecessor inverses, selected source/profile mapping, both complete stage declarations, new finite controls and raw outcomes. Scientific/native/compiler bodies and independent validators remain unchanged. This supplies no complete graph acceptance, authentic runtime admission, all-width theorem, full baseline equality or performance result.

## Task and overlap

Original investigation: #6321. [Maintained specification, PR map and contributor handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321#issuecomment-6713710045).

Base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. Immediate source: #6864 at `c8f7bd582ffc1301b851dde2364c60f1636aac8b`. Adopted construction: #6866 at `fcba647106f3e2f08de1b39ebed04a13c0a6ef8b`. Conditional native/compiler argument: #6830 at `39fcd67c991bd72918080b1d2c02feb3d679206d`.

Reuse #6866 instead of inventing another group owner. Retain #6864 factory/cwd and predecessor timer repairs. Adapt the primary-preserving cleanup discipline from #6339, respecting #6346's allocation/snapshot caveats. Keep #6837/#6847's primary-baseline transfer and #6762's successful-CLOSE adoption as separate open obligations.

Bounded all-author/all-state PR-body searches covered WNOWAIT, run_group_capture and post-reap behavior; the implicated heads and actual cleanup/queue sources were inspected. An unrelated merged Windows Git stdin repair was excluded by its contract. Main was refreshed before publication. This is a proportional overlap check, not an exhaustive novelty claim. Scope is refined from the public construction to its connected implementation and the actual enclosing owner.

## Validation

- Fifteen new methods passed once in normal mode (0.327 s) and optimized mode (0.306 s), exercising actual selected group/predecessor source against labelled inert ports. They expose the old identity-reuse signal and verify retained ownership, once-only consuming wait, error order, capture handling, uncertainty and bindings.
- Eight distinct new methods passed once in normal mode (0.547 s) and optimized mode (0.525 s). They reproduce the old outer context's error masking; check the corrected actual lock-owner/finalizer statements using an inert working-body port; retain all six errors; check administrative-exit ordering and the actual stderr-sensitive queue predicate; reject stale runner/both stage pins and changed scientific/independent-validator inventory; and verify literal inverses and the full changed graph.
- The second operation verifies the group function is byte-identical to the first tested successor. The unchanged fifteen-method suite was not rerun.
- Each operation used clean Python 3.12, a 20-second timeout, two-second kill tail, 256 MiB AS cap and fixed output limits, with a nonrefundable 26-policy-second debit. These are fixture durations, not speedups. No actual Popen, signal, flock, guardian, compiler/native target, financial context or scientific workload ran. Return-code fixtures are not the original full optimized-refusal execution.
- Passive `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` passed for all 92 listed files; SHA256SUMS is the 93rd export file. The source map covers 61 roles and seven profiles on 66 distinct leaves. Both stage declarations retain 197-member inventories; unchanged scientific member bodies and 44 historical control references remain at exact predecessor paths. The 2,115,419-byte archive records the original absolute subject paths and is not a portable executable installation.

Pro reviewed the public predecessor/construction and identified the outer correction; it did not review the unpublished complete successor graph. Codex reviewed the exact correction, source inverse, dependent pins and recorded controls. Independent complete-graph acceptance remains open. No scientific replay hook is registered; hosted planning and skipped replay will be reported at the actual head. Physical preparation/Pro/review/reporting/publication/final-metadata costs and historical gaps remain `OPEN_NOT_ZERO`.

## Credit

Chris R / Clear1nsight; original CrocSwap authors and the #6321/#6864/#6866/#6830 predecessors; primary-preserving cleanup #6339 and allocation/snapshot analysis #6346, with substantial OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT Pro assistance. Preserve original source notices and licences. AI reasoning is distinct from independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

## Open next questions

Independently accept the exact changed runner, enclosing lock, both recipes and complete source/helper/driver/native closure. Verify fresh-exec/default-SIGCHLD, no-auto-reap, exclusive wait and strong-reference premises. The local blocking wait after signal failure has no proved local completion bound; existing outer ownership remains necessary. In-process custody is not durable after runner death, and descendant emptiness remains unknown.

Then connect the genuine primary baseline/full comparison from #6837/#6847 and successful complete-outcome CLOSE from #6762 through the actual caller. Current native/kernel/compiler/configuration, ownership, resource/funding admission and complete normal/optimized outcomes remain prerequisites. Begin from SOURCE-MAP.json, PRO-REVIEW.md and the two literal source inverses; do not replace missing genuine inputs with fixture success records.
